newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London firm on Tokyo lead.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London firm on Tokyo lead.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London extended gains on Thursday following Tokyo's strong lead, with agressive buying of all exporter shares, traders said.
"A few of the stocks saw sharp sell offs at the Tokyo close, but I'd expect them to make up any loss at tomorrow's open," one trader said.
The Nikkei 50/Ise share index in London finished at 1,449.44, up 35.94 points or 2.54 percent from Wednesday's close.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei-225 closed some 278 points or 1.51 percent higher at 18,688.06.
Among individual share features, Sony was among the day's best performers, closing at 9,115 yen in London after finishing at 9,070 yen in Tokyo.
Traders said they expected to see a firm opening in Tokyo on Friday but said blue chip shares could then succumb to profit-taking.
"The market looks fairly toppy at these levels," one trader said.
